bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
echo STARTLESS_UNKNOWN_KIND_COUNTS
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "SELECT kind,state,COUNT(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY kind,state ORDER BY kind,state;"'
echo STARTLESS_UNKNOWN_ROWS_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "SELECT kind,identity,chat_id,message_id FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state=chr(117)||chr(110)||chr(99)||chr(101)||chr(114)||chr(116)||chr(97)||chr(105)||chr(110) ORDER BY kind,chat_id,message_id;"'
echo STARTLESS_UNKNOWN_ROWS_END
echo STARTLESS_ALL_POSTS_PENDING
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs --dry-run || test "$?" -eq 2
